name: PM2.5 against WHO 2021 Air Quality Guidelines

sources.title: WHO global air quality guidelines (2021), Table 0.1, as reproduced in ETC HE Report 2024/17 Table 1.2

categories.label: Meets WHO guideline
categories.health: At or below the WHO 24-h guideline level (15 ug/m3).

categories.label: Interim target 4
categories.health: Above the guideline, within interim target 4 (25 ug/m3).

categories.label: Above all WHO targets
categories.health: Above every WHO interim target. Reduce outdoor exertion.

rules: The 24-h mean PM2.5 is compared with the WHO 2021 24-h AQG level (15) and interim targets IT4 25, IT3 37.5, IT2 50, IT1 75 (ug/m3), using inclusive upper bounds and no rounding.
The API also reports the concentration as a multiple of the guideline (C / 15), which is easy to compare across countries.
notes: reference_guidelines lists [IT1, IT2, IT3, IT4, AQG] for every pollutant. Insight pages use it for annual comparisons.
Requiring 18 of 24 valid hours is our choice, matching the strictest 24-h rule used elsewhere in AirAtlas.
